products.name: VoiceCore
products.quote: The receptionist who never sleeps, never misses a call, and never forgets a customer.
products.problem: Every unanswered call is a customer calling the next business on the list. A full-time receptionist is expensive and inconsistent outside office hours — yet in Uganda, a large share of real bookings begin as an after-hours call or WhatsApp message.
products.experience: VoiceCore should never feel like “a bot.” It answers in a warm, branded voice the client helps choose, with a name and a greeting written to sound like the best receptionist the business has ever had. It listens across phone, WhatsApp and web chat, and remembers the same conversation across all three. The client’s dashboard is not a log file — it is a live conversation feed, every call and chat tagged automatically as a booking, a complaint, a lead, or a general question. When a human steps in, they see the full history instantly; the customer never repeats themselves, and neither does the business.
capabilities: 24/7 call, WhatsApp and web-chat answering — one memory across all three
Live appointment booking synced to the client’s real calendar
Automatic lead capture and CRM logging
English, Luganda and Swahili out of the box
Seamless human hand-off with full transcript and context
After-call WhatsApp or SMS summary sent to the customer
signature: A named, branded voice persona the client helps design — never a generic robotic voice
Automatic monthly “Voice of the Customer” brief: a one-page, boardroom-styled summary of themes, complaints and missed opportunities
Custom-branded hold greeting and confirmation jingle
Optional outbound confirmation calls recorded in the owner’s own voice
products.buildNotes: Extends the Bulk-SMS Dashboard’s existing Africa’s Talking integration with a voice/IVR layer and a speech pipeline. Booking events write straight into InvCore for invoice-ready jobs.
products.positioning: Sold as “the cost of one missed customer a month,” not a software licence — setup deposit plus a monthly seat fee tiered by call volume.
priceModel: Monthly seat fee, tiered by call volume

products.name: ScoreCore
products.quote: Turn every mobile-money transaction into a lending decision a board can defend.
products.problem: Good borrowers are turned away daily for having no bank statement — only a phone full of MTN MoMo and Airtel Money history. Manual loan review takes SACCOs days, and the final call is often a guess dressed up as policy.
products.experience: ScoreCore should never feel like a black box. A loan officer connects or uploads a member’s mobile-money history and, within minutes, receives a clean, single-page credit memo — the kind a commercial bank underwriter would produce — written in plain language: reasons to lend, reasons to be cautious, and a confidence band, never a bare number. It is watermarked with the SACCO’s own logo, so a small rural SACCO can hand a member, a donor, or a regulator something that reads like it came from a modern financial institution.
capabilities: Mobile-money transaction pattern analysis (MTN MoMo, Airtel Money)
Scoring model tuned to Ugandan financial behaviour — e.g. regular family transfers read as stability, not suspicion
Plain-language, explainable credit memos, not a bare score
Repayment tracking integration with PayCore UG
Fraud and score-gaming pattern flags
Full audit trail for UMRA and internal compliance review
signature: Branded, watermarked one-page credit memo per loan applicant
A boardroom-style portfolio risk dashboard for SACCO leadership
Quarterly “Portfolio Health” report, designed like an annual-report page, fit for an AGM or a donor meeting
products.buildNotes: Sits beside ComplyCore UG — SACCOs are already ComplyCore’s target client — and reports into PayCore UG for repayment tracking. ComplyCore’s compliance framing is what earns the trust to handle this data at all.
products.positioning: Per-SACCO licence plus a per-score usage fee, positioned against the cost of one bad loan avoided — not against the price of software.

products.summary: Reads a member’s MTN MoMo and Airtel Money history and returns a bank-grade, plain-language credit memo in minutes — with the reasons, not just a number.

products.name: RadarCore
products.quote: Google isn’t where your next customer is asking anymore.
products.problem: Clients whose websites BDS has already built have never once checked whether ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity mention their business when someone asks “best clinic in Entebbe” or “best hotel near Lake Victoria.” Right now, most are invisible.
products.experience: RadarCore should feel like a boardroom scorecard, not an SEO report. The client receives a magazine-styled “AI Visibility Report”: the real questions a customer might ask an AI, whether the business was mentioned, which competitors were named instead, and exactly why — missing structured data, thin reviews, unclear service pages. A small live dashboard then tracks one number over time — were we mentioned this week — checked the way an owner checks a stock price. The most premium page in the report: the client versus their three biggest rivals, visibility measured head to head.
capabilities: Multi-engine AI-mention auditing (ChatGPT, Gemini, Perplexity and others)
Competitor AI-visibility comparison, head to head
Structured data and schema implementation on the client’s site
“Answer-ready” content rewrites engineered to be cited
Monthly re-audit with a running visibility trend
signature: Magazine-styled AI Visibility Report, not a spreadsheet
A live “AI Mention Tracker” dashboard the client checks monthly
An “AI-Visibility Verified” badge for the client’s own site — a trust signal that quietly markets BDS too
products.buildNotes: The audit draws on the AI-citation tooling already connected to BDS’s workflow; content rewrites plug into the existing web-build service; the dashboard reuses the portfolio hub’s Netlify/Supabase stack.
products.positioning: Sold as a premium retainer add-on to every new website build — “your site is finished, now let’s make sure the AI is answering with your name in it” — never as a stand-alone discount service.

products.name: EmployCore
products.quote: The same AI team running BDS, now working for your business.
products.problem: Most SMEs cannot afford a receptionist, a bookkeeper and a marketer, so the owner does all three badly, at midnight, instead of running the business.
products.experience: EmployCore should be onboarded like a real hire, never switched on like software. The client “meets” their new AI team by name, with a short introduction and a one-page employee handbook describing exactly what each one does and does not do. Every week, the owner receives a one-page manager’s report — the same weekly rhythm BDS already runs on itself — summarising what got done, what’s outstanding, and what needs a decision. The rarest, most premium detail: the client can watch their AI team’s activity log in real time, the same transparency BDS uses internally, which is the one thing no generic chatbot vendor can show.
capabilities: Modular roles the client mixes: Reception, Bookkeeping, Marketing, Sales follow-up
Reception role built on the same voice/WhatsApp layer as VoiceCore
Bookkeeping role wired into InvCore for invoices and expense tracking
Weekly one-page manager’s report to the owner
Read-only by default on anything sensitive — nothing acts without approval until switched on
signature: A named, branded persona per hired role, introduced like a real new employee
A printed or PDF employee handbook for each role
A monthly review call styled like a genuine staff performance review
products.buildNotes: Productises BDS’s own internal Veronica / Jarvis / Marvin / Mannie operating model as a permissioned, multi-tenant service — reusing the Reception layer from VoiceCore and the Bookkeeping layer from InvCore.
products.positioning: Priced per role hired, like fractional staff rather than software seats — the full team sold as a bundle at a premium to any single role.
